newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: SOCCER-ASPRILLA HAILS SHEARER BUT KEEPS QUIET ON TRANSFER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ASPRILLA HAILS SHEARER BUT KEEPS QUIET ON TRANSFER.

text.p: Newcastle United's Colombian striker Faustino Asprilla played down rumours of an imminent transfer on Sunday but hailed his club team mate Alan Shearer as one of the greatest players in the world.

Asprilla, back in Colombia for their World Cup qualifying match with Argentina on Wednesday, admitted in a local newspaper interview that he would love to play for Atletico Nacional, based in Colombia's main industrial city Medellin, but would not expand on the matter.

Asprilla's career at Newcastle began under former manager Kevin Keegan although long periods as a substitute led to rumours of discontent. Those were stoked when Shearer joined the club at the start of this season for a world record 15 million pounds ($24.5 million).
But Asprilla had only good words for both men.
"It's difficult to say (who is the best player in the world) because there are so many but among the best are George Weah, Alan Shearer and Ronaldo," Asprilla said about the England captain.
Asprilla added that he had learned a lot from Keegan in spite of the fact that he was never given an extended run in the team.
"I learned a lot from Kevin. He always wanted me to do well in Newcastle," he said.
